honest_caveats_for_the_rereviewer: This lane's disposition is COMPLETE and READY FOR REREVIEW, not accepted. Acceptance requires the independent rerereview the commission mandates.

THE BIGGEST CAVEAT IS THE API CHANGE. All three authority-consuming entry points now REQUIRE the authoritative request, receipt and rule. Any caller outside this repository's courts must be updated. That is a deliberate breaking change and it IS the repair, but it should be reviewed as a contract change, not only as a bug fix.
BINDING_RULE_REPLAY_MISMATCH was removed as unreachable, so a tampered F8 rule now refuses with BINDING_REPLAY_MISMATCH. If any downstream consumer matches on reason codes, that vocabulary changed.

The three existing binding courts had their call sites rewritten to thread the authority inputs. That is 20 hoisted request variables plus updated call sites; the reviewers should confirm no test was weakened. Two assertions were retargeted at the authentication-stage code rather than loosened, and one was tightened to isolate the signal it claims to measure.

Power 1 and power 2 signatures changed. A downstream adopter calling assert_query_source_admitted(query) or expose_unranked_admitted_source_set() will now get a TypeError rather than an answer. That is intended fail-closed behaviour, but it is a visible break.

The currentness result is recovered from the binding in order to re-derive exactly. This is safe because re-derivation re-validates it against the request, but it is a recovery rather than a caller-supplied input, and a reviewer should confirm that is acceptable.
The 139 pre-existing failing/error identities remain in the tree, untouched by design and out of scope.

Removing the dead rule-hash check is a judgement call. The argument is that authentication is strictly stronger and is now the single enforcement point, and that leaving unreachable code with an overstating comment is the F3 defect class. A reviewer who prefers defence-in-depth should say so explicitly.
The negative control used a shadow tree outside the repository with the pre-authentication binder substituted. It proves witness sensitivity; it does not replace independent reproduction.
what_the_rereviewer_should_attack_first: Whether ANY remaining public path can report eligibility or reach F8 without passing through _authenticate_binding_against_authority. Enumerate the module's public surface independently of this lane's census.
Whether closing power 1 and power 2, not just the evaluator, was correct scope, or whether it over-reaches beyond the commissioned evaluation path.
Whether recovering currentness_result from the binding creates any divergence between what was bound and what is re-derived.
Whether the 20 hoisted request variables in the existing courts introduced any weakened assertion.
Whether removing BINDING_RULE_REPLAY_MISMATCH is right, or whether defence-in-depth was the better call.
